incoming.name: History of the Australian Capital Territory
incoming.excerpt: The NCDC oversaw the construction of Lake Burley Griffin and the completion of Griffin's Parliamentary Triangle in 1964.

outgoing.name: Australia
outgoing.excerpt: Lake Burley Griffin is a lake in the centre of Canberra, Australia's federal capital city.

outgoing.name: Dam
outgoing.excerpt: It was created in 1963 after the Molonglo River, which runs through the city centre, was dammed.

outgoing.name: Elizabeth II of the United Kingdom
outgoing.excerpt: On 25 April 1970, Queen Elizabeth II officially inaugurated the memorial.

outgoing.name: Fishing
outgoing.excerpt: Though swimming in the lake is uncommon, it is used for a wide variety of other activities, such as rowing, fishing, and sailing.

outgoing.name: Brown trout
